extDescription.message: Set the volume of each tab from 0% up to 1000%, and remember it per site.

noMedia.message: No audio or video found on this page yet.

siteRuleOff.message: Open future pages on $1 at this volume.

unavailableDesc.message: Firefox doesn't let add-ons run on built-in pages or addons.mozilla.org.

deniedDesc.message: Tab Amp needs access to websites to control the audio on them.

warnTabMutedDesc.message: Firefox has muted the tab, so you won't hear any change.

warnGestureDesc.message: Firefox only allows boosting after you interact with the page.

warnLimitedDesc.message: Their audio comes from another site without permission to process it (CORS), so they can only be turned down.

optionsMaxDesc.message: The top of the volume slider. Very high values can distort audio.

optionsRulesDesc.message: Pages on these sites open at the remembered volume. Changes apply the next time a page loads.

optionsRulesEmptyDesc.message: Turn on “Remember for this site” in the popup to add one.

optionsAbout1.message: Each tab has its own volume. It stays while you browse the same site in that tab and resets when the tab goes to another site.

optionsAbout2.message: Site rules set the starting volume for pages on that site. A volume set in a tab takes priority.

optionsAbout3.message: Going above 100% uses the Web Audio API. Media served from another site without CORS can only be turned down.
